title: Noise Stability Bound for Odd BLR
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\\varepsilon\\in[0,1]$, let $\\rho\\in[0,1]$, and suppose $\\varepsilon\\le 1-\\rho^2$. For every function $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$ taking values in $[-1,1]$, if for each coordinate $i$ the sum $\\sum_{S\\ni i}(1-\\varepsilon)^{|S|-1}\\widehat f(S)^2$ is at most $\\varepsilon$, then the odd BLR acceptance probability of the noise-smoothed function at noise parameter $\\rho$ is at most $\\frac12+\\frac{\\sqrt{\\varepsilon}}2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube with values in $[-1,1]$
Every coordinate's stable influence at parameter $1-\\varepsilon$ is at most $\\varepsilon$
